name: an unreachable node is reported in-band, not as an error
description: GET /api/db/servers is the one endpoint that does not turn a dead database into a 5xx: an unreachable node appears in the array with connectionStatus 'fail', because 'this server is down' is exactly what the health report exists to say. So this is a 200, and the refKey (db1:3306) is present on purpose — it is the public identifier of the node, not a leak. What must still not appear is the configured password or a fragment of SQL: the health report may name the server it probed and carry the driver's reason, but never a credential or a query.
